explanation: OEIS A211417 (a(n) = (30n)! n!/((15n)! (10n)! (6n)!)), P. Bala: 'It appears that a(n)/(30*n − 1) is integral for all n' (proved per the entry). The formal a (exact division of factorials, an integer) and the integer divisibility (30n − 1) | a(n) match; for n = 0 this is (−1) | 1. Faithful.
